description: The Stage 4 review loop entrypoint (entrypoint/review_loop.py, main()) sets its git identity by running git config --global user.name and user.email 'Holon Review Loop Agent' inside the container. On the host the repository config shared by every worktree of the repository has been seen holding that identity, so host-side merge and sync commits and a conflict merge made by hand in a flow worktree were authored as 'Holon Review Loop Agent' instead of the person committing. Some mounted-config or HOME resolution makes the container's 'global' config land in the shared repository config. flow/review/git_identity.py already defines REVIEW_GIT_ENV (GIT_AUTHOR_* and GIT_COMMITTER_* values) used for review-loop ledger commits.
goal: The review loop sets its git identity per process through the GIT_AUTHOR_NAME, GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL, GIT_COMMITTER_NAME and GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL environment variables taken from REVIEW_GIT_ENV (applied to the entrypoint's own environment so every git command it spawns, including resolver and conflict-merge commits and pushes, carries them), and no longer runs git config user.name or user.email in any scope. Every commit the loop makes is still authored as 'Holon Review Loop Agent'. The safe.directory entry may stay as is.
rationale: A per-process identity cannot leak into a repository config shared with host worktrees, so commits made on the host keep the committer's own identity and the audit trail by author stays usable.
acceptance_criteria: The review loop entrypoint contains no git config call that sets user.name or user.email, in any scope; a test asserts this against the commands run by main() with a recording run_cmd.
After the identity step the process environment holds the four GIT_AUTHOR_* and GIT_COMMITTER_* values from REVIEW_GIT_ENV; a test asserts it and restores the environment afterwards.

A commit made through the entrypoint's git helpers in a hermetic tmp_path repository with no user.name or user.email configured is authored and committed as 'Holon Review Loop Agent'; a test asserts it, and a second test shows the repository's local config still has no user section afterwards.
Existing review loop tests still pass; holon-config/hygiene/module_budgets.json is unchanged and every module stays within its budget.
'uv run pytest' on the changed and added tests, 'uv run task lint' and 'uv run task lint-docs' pass.
